description: This Python script generates new recipe scraper modules and associated test data, including code templating, file creation, and registration within the project.

classes.name: _TemplateReplacer
classes.description: Class responsible for replacing template placeholders in the scraper code with specific class name and host.

classes.name: _InitRegistrar
classes.description: Class responsible for registering the new scraper class in the __init__.py file.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates scraper generation, test data creation, and registration based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: _generate_scraper
methods.description: Reads a template file, applies replacements, and writes out a new scraper module.

methods.name: _generate_tests_and_data
methods.description: Creates test HTML and JSON data files for the new scraper.

methods.name: _register_scraper
methods.description: Updates __init__.py to include the new scraper class.
